entries.proposition: THE SUBTYPE DIRECTIONS ARE HEDGED IN THE SOURCE AND MUST BE HEDGED IN THE CLAIM: the paper says TENDED, and CC-20260922-CLAIM025-SIGN-INVARIANCE-01's delta-2 wording ('si associa a DFS peggiore') is stronger than this sentence. Read first-hand 2026-09-27, which discharges that candidate's blocking verification item 1.
entries.snippet: Patients with Basal-like and HER2-enriched BRCA tended to show more favourable DFS in the high-ratio group, whereas those with Luminal A, Luminal B, and OV tumours showed more favourable DFS in the low-ratio group
entries.anchor: Results, 'Patient Stratification and Subtype Composition', Kaplan-Meier paragraph

entries.proposition: THE SOURCE ITSELF REFUSES THE PROGNOSTIC READING OF THOSE DIRECTIONS. This is the sentence that licenses a QUALIFY of CLAIM 025 and forbids any strengthening of it.
entries.snippet: Given the modest number of DFS events per subtype and the exploratory nature of the subgroup cutpoints, these effects are descriptive and hypothesis-generating rather than formally validated prognostic groupings.
entries.anchor: Results, 'Patient Stratification and Subtype Composition', sentence immediately following the subtype-direction sentence

entries.proposition: WHAT THE PAPER GENUINELY STRENGTHENS IS THE RATIO ARCHITECTURE, NOT THE SIGN: in the combined model the ratio survives and the single transcripts do not. This is CLAIM 025's core architectural proposition and the half that must not be lost in qualifying the claim.
entries.snippet: remained significant in the combined model with WWOX and HIF1A (HR 0.31, 95% CI 0.14–0.70, p = 4.8 × 10−3), whereas the individual genes lost significance
entries.anchor: Results, continuous-ratio Cox models, BRCA sentence

entries.proposition: AND THE DISCRIMINATION IS NEGLIGIBLE ONCE OPTIMISM IS CORRECTED, which is why this source can refuse a direction and cannot raise a corroboration weight.
entries.snippet: the optimism-corrected C-indices were centred close to 0 with a wide interval (approximately −0.50 to 0.46)
entries.anchor: Results, LASSO-Cox full breast cohort, bootstrap internal validation sentence

entries.proposition: THE OVARIAN COHORT -- THE LARGER ONE -- IS NOT SIGNIFICANT AT ALL in the single-predictor model, which is the second half of the evidence boundary proposed for CLAIM 025.
entries.snippet: In OV, the ratio was not significantly associated with DFS in the single-predictor model (HR 1.11, 95% CI 0.92–1.35, p = 0.27; concordance 0.49)
entries.anchor: Results, continuous-ratio Cox models, OV sentence

entries.proposition: LUMINAL A, THE LARGEST BREAST SUBTYPE STRATUM, IS n = 181 - SMALLER THAN OV's 228, which is what makes OV the largest of the five strata. Added 2026-09-28 (mirror003 repairs, Mirror N4).
entries.snippet: Subtype-specific analyses were strictly constrained by very low DFS event counts (for example, Luminal A: n = 181).

entries.proposition: THE OVARIAN NULL IS NOT AN UNDERPOWERED ONE AND THE BREAST COHORT'S SIGNIFICANCE IS THE POOR-EVENT ONE: the OV cohort carries 161 events in 228 patients while the larger BRCA cohort carries 22 events in 390 - so the non-significant ovarian HR is an event-rich null, not a small-sample one. Added 2026-09-28 (mirror003 repairs, Mirror N4).
entries.snippet: resulting in final DFS-proxy cohorts of 390 BRCA patients (22 events, 368 censored) and 228 OV patients (161 events, 67 censored)
entries.anchor: Methods 5.1, cohort-assembly sentence, citing Supplementary Tables S1 and S2

entries.proposition: The Results state that higher ratios go with enhanced oxidative phosphorylation in basal-like and HER2-enriched tumours; the same paragraph names KEGG and Hallmark analyses as the basis.
entries.snippet: higher ratios were generally associated with reduced HIF1A-linked glycolytic programmes, enhanced oxidative phosphorylation and ribosomal biogenesis, and more active immune-surveillance microenvironments
entries.anchor: Results, KEGG ORA and Hallmark synthesis paragraph

experimental_context.genotype: low versus high WWOX/HIF1A transcript ratio (subtype-specific maxstat cutpoint), not a WWOX perturbation

entries.proposition: Figure 3 (hand reading, Hallmark GSEA heatmap, 12 rows by 10 columns): HYPOXIA is red (enriched in the LOW-ratio group) in all five strata and GLYCOLYSIS is red in basal-like, luminal A, luminal B and OV, with a pale blue (high-ratio) glycolysis tile in HER2 (blind audit correction: hypoxia was first written as four of five). MYC TARGETS V1 is the one row enriched in the HIGH-ratio group in all five subtypes. There is no OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION row in the figure, and Figure 2 (KEGG ORA) has no oxidative phosphorylation term either, so the sentence cited from the text has no panel behind it in the main figures. In luminal A/B and OV the low-ratio (glycolysis-enriched) group is the one the text calls the BETTER-DFS group, in basal-like the worse-DFS group: the glycolytic signature does not track outcome across subtypes. Because HIF1A is the denominator, low ratio selects high HIF1A transcript (Figure 1, luminal B, p = 5.9e-08), so hypoxia and glycolysis enrichment in the low group is partly built into the stratification. The Discussion states that pathways reaching FDR < 0.05 were few and trends up to FDR 0.25 are shown.

entries.proposition: Figure 2 (KEGG ORA bubble plot) shows 27 terms with no oxidative phosphorylation, glycolysis or TCA term; metabolic terms are steroid hormone biosynthesis and retinol metabolism (luminal A high-ratio), nitrogen metabolism (luminal A low-ratio); signalling and immune terms (JAK-STAT, cytokine, PI3K) dominate the high-ratio luminal A column. Figure 1 shows HIF1A in luminal B (violin, p = 5.9e-08, low-ratio higher) and ADAM10 and DTX3 in basal-like. Figures 4 and 5 are MCPcounter immune-cell boxplots. No survival curve is plotted in any main figure (Kaplan-Meier curves and cutpoint plots are Supplementary Figure S1), so the question about the sign of the per-subtype survival direction cannot be answered from the main figures; it was posed on the assumption that they did.

The stated question assumed a survival panel among the main figures; there is none (Figures 1-5 are Notch genes, KEGG, Hallmark, immune scores).
